description: Phase 86: Wire final dormant modules — HRPOptimizer, ObservationalLearner, LivePositionManager, SmartExecutionEngine. All observational-first (log, not change execution).

userStories.title: Wire HRPOptimizer.get_weights() periodic portfolio weight logging
userStories.description: Every 50 cycles, compute HRP weights from _pair_returns and log the portfolio allocation.

userStories.title: Wire ObservationalLearner.extract_patterns() from crisis generator output
userStories.description: Every 100 cycles (after crisis generator runs), feed synthetic scenarios to extract_patterns and log pattern count.

userStories.title: Wire LivePositionManager.evaluate_position() for open trade monitoring
userStories.description: In scan() after trailing stop evaluation, iterate open trades and call evaluate_position with PositionContext. Log non-HOLD actions at INFO. Observational only — do not auto-execute actions.

userStories.title: Wire SmartExecutionEngine.should_use_smart_execution() observational logging
userStories.description: In execute_trade before order placement, call should_use_smart_execution(lots, atr_pips) and log whether slicing would be recommended. Observational only.
